title: Y1DZ--673-901 Brooksville CBOC Renovation Minor  Design-Build - Brooksville, FL
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > PCAC HEALTH INFORMATION (36C776)
description:
SYNOPSIS:
INTRODUCTION: 
This Sources Sought Notice is for market research and information purposes only at this time and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA).
The VA Office of Facilities Acquisition (OFA), Program Contracting Activity Center (PCAC) is conducting a market research to identify qualified sources capable of performing a Design-Build (DB) project. Services to include Architect and Engineering (DB A/E) design services, site preparation and DB Construction (DB C) services for the renovation of the Brooksville Community-Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) at the Brooksville VA Clinic located at 14540 Cortez Boulevard, Suite 108, Brooksville, Florida 34613-6001.
PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
The Department of Veterans Affairs has a requirement for a Design-Build renovation of the Brooksville Community-Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) under Project No. 673-901. The project includes completion of the remaining design effort, validation of existing conditions, preparation of final construction documents, and execution of construction activities necessary to renovate and modernize the facility in accordance with current VA standards, life safety requirements, operational needs, and applicable VA criteria. 
This Design-Build project includes all necessary architectural, engineering, specialty consulting, commissioning, and construction services required to deliver a complete and operational renovation. The scope includes review and incorporation of prior design documents, infrastructure upgrades to HVAC and electrical systems, OI&T/telecommunications improvements, safety and security enhancements, fire protection improvements, building envelope repairs, roof and water intrusion remediation, and all associated architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, low-voltage, civil, and site-related work.
The contractor shall perform comprehensive site investigation and field verification of existing conditions and develop detailed phasing, infection control, containment, and construction logistics plans to support continued operation of the clinic during construction. Work shall be coordinated with facility stakeholders to maintain safe access for patients and staff while minimizing disruptions to healthcare services. Construction barriers, access routes, temporary utility requirements, dust control measures, and shutdown coordination shall be incorporated into the project design and execution.
The completed project shall provide modernized and reliable facility infrastructure that supports ongoing clinical operations, improves building performance, addresses life safety and code compliance requirements, mitigates water intrusion and building envelope deficiencies, and enhances telecommunications, security, and fire protection systems throughout the facility. All completed work shall be fully commissioned, tested, and integrated with existing VA systems and infrastructure in accordance with applicable VA standards and requirements.
PROCUREMENT INFORMATION:
The proposed project will be a competitive, firm-fixed-price contract utilizing the design-build approach outlined in Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) 36-101-2, Use of two-phase design-build selection procedures. The results and analysis of the market research will finalize the determination of the procurement method. The type of socio-economic set-aside, if any, will depend upon the responses to this notice and any other information gathered during the market research process.
The Government anticipates advertising this project in the timeframe of late December 2026 to early January 2027. The VAPM Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $20,000.000.00 and $50,000,000.00. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220 applies to this procurement. The duration of the project is currently estimated at 740 calendar days from the issuance of a Notice to Proceed. The services for this project will include providing all design and construction related services. 
CAPABILITY STATEMENT:
Respondents shall provide a general capabilities statement to include the following information: 
Section 1: Provide company name, DUNS number and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), company address, Point-of-Contact name, phone number and email.
Section 2: Provide company business size based on NAICS code 236220. Also, provide business type (i.e., Large Business, Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business, Women-Owned Small Business, Hub Zone Small Business, etc.). 
Section 3: Provide a statement of interest in the project.
Section 4: Provide the prime contractor s available bonding capacity in the form of a letter of intent from your bonding company with this submission. *Please ensure that the individual bonding capacity is in line with the VAPM Magnitude of Construction listed above.
Section 5: Provide the type of work your company has performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirement. This section is IMPORTANT as it will help to determine the type of socio-economic set-aside, if any. Please provide the following in your response: 
Provide a maximum of three (3) projects completed within the last ten years (10) years in which the Offeror s design-build team has worked together on previous design-build contracts similar in size, magnitude, complexity, and scope to this project. Projects must demonstrate a respondent s design-build experience as a prime construction contractor directly responsible to the owner and managing multiple subcontractors. NOTE: If a prime contractor does not have Design-Build experience, they are permitted to provide up to three (3) relevant non-Design-Build projects that are completed in clinical, hospital or other medical related use space similar in size, magnitude, complexity, and scope to this project.
